snippet.title: The Witch's Bakery | Official Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
RELEASE DATE UPDATE: Coming 14 October to all platforms! Wishlist NOW! 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967950?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=TWB_release_teaser&utm_medium=description
Nintendo Switch:
Nintendo Switch 2:
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017135/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/the-witchs-bakery/9NPJ9XJSCL67
Pre-order physical: https://direct.silverliningint.com/search?q=the+witch%27s+bakery

The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!
